title: Volume Discount by Billed Therms on Commercial Natural Gas Supply Renewals After Rollover
content:
A volume discount is taken off the Commercial Natural Gas Supply offer price, on a renewal accepted after rollover, by the therms billed on the agreement's energy charge lines whose billing period start is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date:

| Therms on those energy charge lines | Volume discount per therm |
|---|---|
| At least 30000 | $0.0100 |
| At least 15000 and fewer than 30000 | $0.0050 |
| Fewer than 15000 | None |

The discount is a per-therm amount taken off the offer price once. Only energy charge lines count; swing excess and swing shortfall lines are not energy charge lines.

## Edges of each band

| Therms in the window | Discount |
|---|---|
| 30000 | $0.0100 |
| 29999 | $0.0050 |
| 15000 | $0.0050 |
| 14999 | None |

## Window illustration (hypothetical acceptance date 2026-01-10)

Energy charge lines with billing period starts from 2025-01-11 onward are summed; a line whose billing period start is 2025-01-10 is outside the window.
